'''Mandalore''' was the name of the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], which was located in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The star was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by nine [[Planet/Legends|planets]]: [[Nog]], [[Akaan]], [[Tracyn]], [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]], [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Mandallia]], [[Bonagal]], [[Shukut/Legends|Shukut]], and [[Werda]].<ref name="TEA" />
